header.comment: Configuration for the courtier GPU consumer (Gem::Courtier::GPU::GGPUConsumerT).
It selects the device-programming model AND the kernel, so the same program can
switch between CPU / CUDA without recompilation.
FLOAT variant: used when example 15 is built with GIMAGE_USE_FLOAT (FP32 kernel).

backend.comment: 'cpu' runs the marshaller's host reference evaluation (always available);
'cuda' requires the CUDA backend to have been compiled into
gemfony-courtier (it falls back to 'cpu' with a warning otherwise).

kernel_path.comment: Path to the kernel source (.cu for CUDA via NVRTC),
or a prebuilt module (.ptx/.cubin). Resolved relative to the working directory.

kernel_entry.comment: Kernel entry-point name (must be un-mangled, e.g. extern "C").
